author: hasl
body:
Hello all o/,

Recently it has come to my attention of the quality of dealing with staff reports and appeals. I feel it's become more developed and fair, however we can't stress how rewarding community feedback can be.

The results will be gathered and taken to thought.

Please complete this survey: https://blizzem.typeform.com/to/WK9x4h

Again, we really appreciate your opinions on this. Be honest, all submits are anonymous. However, if we find you have been trolling the survey you will then by punished accordingly.

Kind regards,

-The Avicus Staff / Senior Staff Team.
